remarks:
Serenity, Views & Dreams – 20 Acres on Fairview Road, Farmersville Station, NY

Set against the backdrop of Allegany County’s quiet countryside, this 20-acre parcel on Fairview Road offers a scenic and versatile slice of rural paradise. Once a cultivated farm field, the land now boasts wide-open views to the south and east, creating an inspiring canvas for your future Dream home, cabin, or recreational retreat.

With approximately 1,000 feet of road frontage, the property rolls gently across the landscape and is bordered by a peaceful creek along its southern edge—adding a touch of natural seclusion and wildlife appeal. A mix of open land and treed borders makes it ideal for everything from homesteading and hiking to hunting or simply enjoying the outdoors.

Electric service and high-speed internet are available right at the road, and easy year-round access adds convenience without compromising the sense of privacy and escape. Whether you're looking to build now or invest for the future, this land offers space, beauty, and boundless potential.

Come walk the land and experience it for yourself—your dream country lifestyle begins here.
